checks.finding: Accepted. Existence must count one state with both strict inequalities; two positive maxima do not suffice. For a nonempty finite fiber the two positive minima are exactly equivalent to all states jointly positive.
Accepted. g is one global state label; unknown-g union and both known-g conditional regimes remain separate. No favorable g selection, cross-entry g mixing, or averaging.

Accepted. Numeric signatures are deduplicated within g, tagged and untagged full tuples counted separately, redundant case/r origins never weight states. P depends on signatures, so tag dedup changes counts but not extrema or class.

Accepted. F02 factorization requires all three stated premises, not only zero score coefficient. The append-v argument proves identical core fibers; state-count and feasible-observation factors are distinguished correctly. Full 64 decoder remains mandatory.

Accepted. A common global-union alphabet exposes known-g incompatibility. Schema-valid but incompatible input is CONFLICT with zero counts and null bounds; malformed input is INPUT_ERROR. No vacuous positive result or fabricated zero bounds.

Accepted. Existence-minimal sets, value-specific certificates, and guarantee-minimal sets are distinct; all ties, empty/full subsets, singleton categories and both-known-g guarantees are retained. Inclusion minimality is distinguished from minimum cardinality.

Accepted. Counts are finite-model cardinalities only; no acquisition success probability, image attainability, hidden historical g, independent evidence or restored lost hierarchy is claimed. Positive certification remains only the necessary numeric condition within the inherited outer model.

Accepted. H retains 2 same / 4 different, H4 retains 2 / 2, and difference uses the same assignment. The old 15-pair catalogue/intervals remain; no new conditional individual-pair computation is required by this goal.

Accepted. Compact canonical tables are lossless only with complete dictionaries, all rows, 64 expansion, exact counts and queryable same-g six-entry witnesses with original case/r links. Independent comparison is required for the entire fiber table, not a sample.

Accepted. Fixtures cover strict zero, no joint positive despite marginal maxima, shared-g conflict, redundant origins, unequal-g F02 counterexample, distinct minimalities and all64 direct-enumeration validation. These are scheduled checks, not claimed executed here.
